name: VerseSofts Bulk Order Table
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
VerseSofts Bulk Order Table by VerseSofts is the ultimate efficiency tool for your WooCommerce store. It replaces the traditional slow shopping process with a professional, lightning-fast “Quick Order” table, allowing customers to find and add multiple products to their cart in seconds.

Whether you run a B2B wholesale store, a restaurant supply shop, or a high-volume retail outlet, this plugin significantly reduces checkout friction and encourages larger order volumes.

Key Features

  • AJAX Quick Order Form: A high-performance product table that loads instantly and works without page refreshes.
  • Real-time Search: Customers can find products by Name or SKU instantly as they type.
  • Category Filtering: Easily narrow down products using a clean category dropdown filter.
  • Checkbox Selection: Select multiple products and add them all with a single click.
  • Bulk Quantity Entry: Enter quantities for dozens of products and add them all to the cart at once.
  • Variation Support: Perfectly handles variable products, displaying variations clearly with their own quantity inputs.
  • Shortcode Enabled: Place your bulk order form anywhere using the [versesofts_bulk_order_table] shortcode.
  • HPOS Ready: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage for maximum database speed.
  • Mobile Responsive: A clean, modern UI that works beautifully on desktops, tablets, and phones.

Perfect For

  • B2B & Wholesale: Allow professional buyers to order their usual stock in bulk without clicking through dozens of pages.
  • Office Supplies & Grocery: Ideal for stores where customers typically buy many small items at once.
  • Event Planning: Quick selection for rentals, catering items, or equipment.
  • Industrial Parts: Search by SKU and add multiple parts to the cart instantly.

Professional Tools

  • Intuitive AJAX interface nested in a premium design.
  • Secure processing with nonces and proper data sanitization.
  • Lightweight code following WordPress & WooCommerce coding standards.
  • Translation ready for international stores.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for VerseSofts Bulk Order Table.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Create a new page and paste the [versesofts_bulk_order_table] shortcode.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Upload the versesofts-bulk-order-table folder directly to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I display the bulk order form?

Simply use the shortcode [versesofts_bulk_order_table] on any page, post, or widget area.

Does it support product variations?

Yes! If a product has variations, they will be displayed in the table so customers can select exactly what they need.

Can I customize the number of products shown?

Yes. You can adjust the “Products Per Page” setting in WooCommerce > Settings > VerseSofts Bulk Order Table.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Absolutely. The plugin is 100% compatible with High-Performance Order Storage.
